Ggaba Road, [[Kabalagala]], [[Kampala]], [[Uganda]] | key_people = {{ubl|Harshad Barot ([[Organizational founder|founder]])|Kruti Barot(managing director & [[Miraj Barot]]}}joint managing director num_employees = 2,000+ (2014) | assets = US$100+ million (2014) | revenue = | industry = {{ubl|[[Construction]]|[[Real estate]]}} | products = {{ubl|[[Apartment|Apartment complexes]]|[[Condominium]]s|[[Office towers]]|[[Shopping malls]]}} | website = [http://www.thetirupatigroup.com/ Homepage] }} '''Tirupati Group Limited (TGL)''' is a privately owned real estate development and construction company in [[Uganda]]. Tirupati Group Limited provides development funding and also constructs its own buildings. ==History== The company was established in 2006. During its first five years of existence, the company developed and constructed four projects: (a) ''Tirupati House'' located in the [[Kamwookya]] suburb of the country's capital, [[Kampala]], (b) ''Ovino Market'', a development in the ''Kisenyi Area'', a former slum in the center of Kampala, (c) ''Bugoloobi Executive Apartments'', an upscale development in the suburb of [[Bugoloobi]] and (d) ''Nkumba Village'' a [[mixed-use development]] consisting of university student hostel and a shopping mall, near the campus of [[Nkumba University]], approximately {{convert|8|km|mi}}, by road, northeast of the [[central business district]] of the town of [[Entebbe]]. In 2010, Tirupati was recognized for ‘Introduction of a Novel And Competitive Product In East African Region’, during the 16th Annual Investor of the Year Award Ceremony held by the [[Uganda Investment Authority]]. It was in regard to Tirupati's Ovino Market, in Kisenyi, Kampala.{{cite web|first=John|last=Musinguzi| date=10 February 2010|url=http://www.observer.ug/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=7167:-tirupati-the-regional-leader-in-novelty|title= Tirupati: The Regional Leader In Novelty| access-date=26 November 2014|newspaper=[[The Observer (Uganda)]]}} In June 2014, TGL won a contract to upgrade and renovate [[Masaka Regional Referral Hospital]] for approximately US$4 million (USh:10.6 billion).{{cite web|url=http://observer.ug/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=32267:-masaka-to-get-800-bed-block|date=16 June 2014|first=Andrew|last=Kaggwa|newspaper=[[The Observer (Uganda)]]|title=Masaka Hospital To Get 800-Bed Block| access-date=26 November 2014}}{{cite web|date=11 June 2014|access-date=26 November 2014| url=http://www.newvision.co.ug/news/656464-gov-t-earmarks-sh10b-for-masaka-hospital.html|first=Francis|last=Emorut|newspaper=[[New Vision]] (Kampala)|title=Government Earmarks USh10 Billion for Masaka Hospital}} ==Scope of work== {{asof|November 2014}} the following real estate projects have either been completed or are in development by the company:{{cite web|url=http://www.tirupati-uganda.com/projects.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141125151358/http://www.tirupati-uganda.com/projects.html|archive-date=25 November 2014| title=Projects|access-date=26 November 2014|publisher=Tirupati Development Uganda Limited}} {| class="wikitable sortable" ! style="background-color:#ABCDEF;"|Name of development ! style="background-color:#ABCDEF;"| Location ! style="background-color:#ABCDEF;"| Country ! style="background-color:#ABCDEF;"| Type ! style="background-color:#ABCDEF;"| Capacity ! style="background-color:#ABCDEF;"| Year completed or completion expected ! style="background-color:#ABCDEF;"| Estimated value (US$) ! style="background-color:#ABCDEF;"| Notes |- ! Tirupati House | [[Kamwookya]], [[Kampala]] | [[Uganda]] | Office Tower | 14 Executive Offices & Retail Units | 2008 | 2 million | Houses HQ of TDUL |- |} ==Subsidiary companies== In addition to developing and constructing real estate projects, TGL has several non-real-estate related subsidiaries. '''Bio-Waste Management Limited''' collects and disposes of biomedical and pharmaceutical waste in an environmentally friendly and safe manner. Offices and disposal facilities are located {{convert|30|km|mi}} by road northeast of Kampala.{{cite web|url=http://www.tirupati-uganda.com/tirupati-deveopments-biomedical-waste-management.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304041341/http://www.tirupati-uganda.com/tirupati-deveopments-biomedical-waste-management.html|archive-date=4 March 2016|title=Tirupati Biomedical Waste Services|publisher=Tirupati Development Uganda Limited}} '''Tirupati Agricultural Development Limited''' is an [[agribusiness]] that operates a demonstration farm on {{convert|400|acre|ha}} and maintains a sugarcane plantation on the adjacent {{convert|2500|acre|ha}}. Crops on this demonstration farm include pineapples, maize and onions.
